unresolved_conditions: no approved nozzle contour coordinate origin, direction, units, or geometry version
no traceable segment boundary and representative coordinate definition
no reviewed A(x)/At calculation and throat-location evidence
no reviewed one-to-one segment to CEA station mapping
no approved policy for segments without an exact explicit CEA station

prohibited_fallbacks: do not infer IPA purity, water content, additives, or inlet composition
do not extrapolate properties outside a supplied valid temperature-pressure-phase domain
do not align enthalpy values from different reference states without a documented offset
do not classify single phase from normal boiling point alone
do not select a CEA station by nearest coordinate or area ratio without source-backed mapping
do not interpolate between CEA stations until a separate model and validation basis are approved
do not treat unit-test or synthetic-refinement PASS as V01-V12 physical validation
